newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: FPHC unit, Enron unit sign fuel pact.
newsitem.headline: FPHC unit, Enron unit sign fuel pact.

text.p: First Gas Holdings Corp (FGHC), a joint venture of First Philippine Holdings Corp and British Gas Plc said on Thursday it had signed a $230 million a year pact for the purchase of condensate from Enron Capital and Trade Resources, a unit of Enron Corp.
Federico Lopez, FGHC general manager, told Reuters the supply agreement would cover a period of 15 years, the first long-term condensate agreement in the Philippines.
FGHC President Peter Garrucho said the condensate would be used to run FGHC's 990-megawatt power plant at Batangas, south of Manila.
Lopez said Enron Capital will supply 30,000 to 35,000 barrels a day of condensate to First Gas.
Lopez said FGHC bested a shortlist of six to eight other interested suppliers.
He said local refiners such as Petron Corp, Pilipinas Shell Petroleum Corp and Caltex (Philippines) Inc were invited to bid for the contract but they did not participate.
